value.rationale: Adaptive multistep stability under large ratio oscillations is a documented practical issue. The result gives a complete sharp two-period scalar/SPD negative-real CFL law independent of ratio, the unique optimal budget split and sharp 5/3 worst-case spectral penalty, with a matching explicit warning that transient norms can be ratio-unbounded. These structural all-parameter conclusions go materially beyond known constant-step interval or a single constructed numerical example.
